title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode2 Thanks To The Workshop

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Morning, Emu.
You're here pretty early again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, Rui, good wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, that just leaves Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. He said it's the first day of that workshop he was talking about, so he's probably going to be here a bit later than usual.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He'll be at that workshop until noon and come here to practice afterwards. I have to say, it's a tough schedule...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_shining_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Apologies for being late!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you're not.
Practice doesn't start for another fifteen minutes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, he's always here early, so this may feel quite late to him by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today was the first day of that workshop, right?! Well? What was it like?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad you asked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we have some time before practice, allow me to tell you! If I could sum it up in one word, it was...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Extraordinary!
There's no other way to describe it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Coool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even when we introduced ourselves, it turned into an acting exercise. I remained focused throughout, and the tension made it all the more stimulating!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You had to act out your self-introduction...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you simply do a self-introduction in place of your own self introduction!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that isn't helping.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... How do I put it...?
After telling each other our real names, we were asked to recite the same self-introduction as everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “My name is Taro Sato. I work as a member of the Third Sales Division for Acme Corporation, and I mainly work as a business consultant for our clients. It's a pleasure to meet all of you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...is what we were asked to recite.
And each person gave a different rendition of it based on their own style. For example...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Mine was...
“My name is Taro Sato! I work as a member of the Third Sales Division for Acme Corporation!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
One person's was like...
“My name is...Taro...Sato... I work as a member of the Third Sales Division...for Acme Corporation...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
So it can sound really different depending on who's saying it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely.
Conversely, it's harder to make a lasting impression if you don't have a distinct style...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus, it was a test of our acting skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Interesting...
That sounds really hard, but also really fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I'm particularly interested in hearing more about what the director hosting this workshop is like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. He's a very unique individual, and the exercises he had us do were just as intriguing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I had no issues with that since I'm already more than used to working with such a director!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's all thanks to you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I'm supposed to feel about that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If your first day was this action-packed, you must be looking forward to how the rest of this workshop's going to go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I can't wait to see what else we're going to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me.
Apparently, on the last day, we're supposed to put on a performance at a small auditorium that's being rented out for this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're allowed to invite guests, so I hope you'll come by to watch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! We get to see your guys' show?! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you already know what you'll be performing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, but we have a few candidates lined up. The director said that he'll make a decision once he's seen what everyone is capable of.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, interesting...
Yes, that would probably make for a better show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also very much looking forward to seeing your hard work come to fruition.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
As I!
Just you wait! It'll be an opportunity for you to all see how much I've grown as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, it's about time for practice. Wanna get started?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
How do you feel, Tsukasa? Ready for practice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More than ready! If anything, I couldn't be in a more perfect condition! I'm all warmed up and ready to get started whenever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You certainly sound like it.
Then, let's start with the opening scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “Ah, this must be the sword. The legends state that whoever is able to pull it from this stone is destined to become a hero who saves the world.”

rows.Speaker: Onlooker
rows.Line: “And yet, no one has ever been able to do so. Not even the burliest of men or the most renowned masters of the blade.”

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: “Which is why everyone here believes that it was created to never be pulled out.”

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: “Or maybe it's just trying to tell us that a hero who can save the world hasn't appeared yet.”

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “Hehe. She believes in such fairytales. How cute.”

rows.Speaker: Sage
rows.Line: “However, you are one of her brethren, and you believe that you have the power to free this sword from its prison... Do you not?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“I do not know.
I am no swordsman, nor do I possess the strength to break stone.”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “At the same time, how long has this feeling lingered within me...?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “This inexplicable compulsion to protect the world. It feels as though it has been branded into my soul...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (His acting's different compared to normal. For some reason...it's like what he's doing makes perfect sense.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When read as is, not many people would think to recite that line in the way he just did...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The thought of the weight of the world resting on one's shoulders usually compels the reader to feel very impassioned.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, Tsukasa chose to...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Tsukasa!
I really loved what you did just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So did I.
It was a captivating performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
All this praise is starting to make me feel antsy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your performance was so convincing. How did you come up with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I wasn't happy with my portrayal when I was practicing at home...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I asked one of the other workshop attendees and they said, “I'd try practicing somewhere similar to where it takes place.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Somewhere similar...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't understand what they meant at first. So, I decided to start by taking a literal interpretation and performing by the side of a big boulevard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, the hero from this scene is still a penniless shoe shiner that everyone was too scared to go near...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is understandable...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, that allowed me to see how he truly feels. He's incredibly lonely. He realizes that he is but a miniscule part of a large society.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He has no idea what he can do in or for this world. And yet, this overwhelming sense of duty has been lingering within him for as long as he can remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I believe this role involves him wanting to see whether or not that feeling means anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think he's dealing with an internal battle, where his desire to know is clashing with his fear of disappointment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which led to what we just saw.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just based on the script, I was under the impression that most people would feel compelled to give an impassioned performance of sorts. However, Tsukasa, your interpretation makes perfect sense.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was really awesome!
So awesome that I almost forgot my own lines!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, music to my ears!
It just goes to show that training elsewhere is very important!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've actually been looking for another workshop to attend once this one finishes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also...
It'd be great to make a guest appearance with another troupe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A guest appearance...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's when a member of one troupe performs in a show being put on by another troupe. In other words, a special guest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you wanna perform with another troupe...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to try whatever I can if it means becoming a better actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, there's no need to worry. I plan to do that while also doing performances at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
I'm okay! There's nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What happened just now...?
Things felt really weird for a second there.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa wants to make his dream come true, so it's only natural for him to say that he wants to perform with a different troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, that's why he's attending that workshop, and why I've been supportive of that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What is this feeling...?)
